notes.title: Version 1.1 – A World of Languages Awaits! 🌍✨
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 Brings Multilingual Support to the Game!
We're excited to announce that the game now supports 10 additional languages! Wherever you’re playing from, you can now enjoy the experience in your preferred language.

🌍 New Languages Added:


 Norwegian 🇳🇴
 German 🇩🇪
 French 🇫🇷
 Spanish 🇪🇸
 Italian 🇮🇹
 Polish 🇵🇱
 Portuguese 🇵🇹
 Chinese (Simplified) 🇨🇳
 Japanese 🇯🇵
 Korean 🇰🇷
 Ukrainian 🇺🇦


We hope this update makes the game more accessible and engaging for players around the globe. Thank you for your support – and as always, let us know how we can make the experience even better! 😊
